key_idea: Check every number in a cloud. All of them must be smaller than 8.
steps: Smaller than 8 means 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 or 7. The number 8 itself is not smaller than 8.
Look at each cloud and find any number that is 8 or bigger.
The green cloud B has 1, 6, 2 and 5. All of them are smaller than 8.
Every other cloud has a number that is 8 or bigger.

choice_feedback.A: This cloud has 9. It is bigger than 8.
choice_feedback.C: This cloud has 8. 8 is not smaller than 8.
choice_feedback.D: This cloud has 10. It is bigger than 8.
choice_feedback.E: This cloud has 9. It is bigger than 8.
